proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Sec. 1212, what is the minimum floor area threshold that triggers automatic sprinkler requirements for habitation occupancies?

options.text: 150 square meters of gross floor area per storey
200 square meters of gross floor area per storey
250 square meters of gross floor area per storey

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 specifies a dual trigger: floor area must be 200 sq.m or more AND occupant load must exceed 20 persons. Both conditions must be met for habitation occupancies.
proposed.explanation: The 200 sq.m threshold is only half the trigger. The occupant load condition (>20 persons for habitation, >10 for workshops) must also be satisfied. A 250 sq.m space with only 5 occupants would not trigger the sprinkler requirement.
